proposals.statement: The client's current system has receptionists burning out due to high call volumes and double bookings

evidence.quote: My receptionists are burning out

proposals.statement: The client's current system has receptionists burning out due to high call volumes and double bookings

evidence.quote: Mornings are the worst. Between eight and ten the phones just don't stop, and there's one receptionist per clinic who is also checking people in and taking payments. We miss a lot of calls. And people get double-booked, because someone rubbed out a booking and someone else wrote over it.

proposals.statement: The project should reduce missed calls, double bookings, and no-shows

evidence.quote: The goals are fewer missed calls, no double bookings, and fewer no-shows

proposals.statement: The client uses VetDesk Pro for clinical records, owners' details, vaccination history, and billing

evidence.quote: VetDesk Pro, yes. That's where all the clinical records live, the owners' details, vaccination history, billing.

proposals.statement: The client uses paper diaries at reception for booking appointments

evidence.quote: All three clinics, Centurion, Irene and Olievenhoutbosch, have their own landline and their own paper diary at reception.

proposals.statement: The client's current system has high call volumes that cause missed calls and double bookings

proposals.statement: The client's current system has no-shows that take up thirty-minute slots

evidence.quote: We have maybe twenty no-shows a week across the three clinics. Each one is a thirty-minute slot gone.

proposals.statement: The project should allow pet owners to book appointments online via a website

evidence.quote: They go onto a website on their phone, pick the clinic, pick what it's for, a vaccination, a check-up, a sick pet, and see the open times. They choose one and it's booked.

proposals.statement: The project should send reminders to pet owners the day before an appointment

evidence.quote: They choose one and it's booked. And then they get a reminder the day before.

proposals.statement: The project should automatically send vaccination reminders with a link to book

evidence.quote: If that could go out automatically with a link to book, that's half the work gone.

proposals.statement: The project should allow receptionists to see the day's schedule for their clinic

evidence.quote: They need to see the day for their clinic, move bookings around, and put in phone bookings too, because some of our older clients will never book online.

proposals.statement: The online booking system must only show bookings and reminders, not medical history

evidence.quote: No. Definitely not, not in this project. The vets don't want owners reading clinical notes without someone explaining them. Bookings and reminders only.

proposals.statement: The system must not share data with another system due to VetDesk's API charges and slow implementation

evidence.quote: There is an API.
But they charge for it per clinic, and when the Pretoria East practice asked for it, it took VetDesk three months to switch it on.

proposals.statement: The client expects the system to be live by mid-January to accommodate vaccination season

evidence.quote: Before vaccination season. So live by the first of February at the latest.
Ideally mid-January, so the girls have two weeks to get used to it before the rush.

proposals.statement: The client has allocated 180,000 rand for development and 2,500 rand per month for running costs across three clinics

evidence.quote: We've put aside a hundred and eighty thousand rand to build it. And the running costs, the messages and the hosting, must stay under two and a half thousand a month for all three clinics. That's my limit.

proposals.statement: The client prefers a simple web interface with big buttons, green color scheme, and no app download

evidence.quote: Our green, the logo green. Big buttons, because half the people booking are holding a puppy in the other hand. And no app to download, just a web page.

proposals.statement: The client currently has a system that requires 40 fields per screen, which they want to simplify

evidence.quote: And simple. One screen if possible. The VetDesk screens have about forty fields on them, I don't want that.

proposals.statement: The client plans to add online pet food ordering and payment in the next year

evidence.quote: Ordering pet food online and paying for it, maybe. Next year.
